lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਮ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dharam karaae karam dhurahu phuramaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord has ordained that mortals must practice righteousness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saavan aaiaa he sakhee ka(n)tai chit karehu ||
lines.translation: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; think of your Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jhoor marahi dohaaganee jinh avaree laagaa nehu ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the discarded bride is in love with another; now she weeps and wails, and dies. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਬਰਸਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saavan aaiaa he sakhee jalahar barasanahaar ||
lines.translation: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; the clouds have burst forth with rain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sukh savan sohaaganee jinh sah naal piaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the blessed soul-brides sleep in peace; they are in love with their Husband Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਛਿੰਝ ਪਵਾਇ ਮਲਾਖਾੜਾ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape chhi(n)jh pavaai malaakhaaRaa rachiaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself has staged the tournament, and arranged the arena for the wrestlers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਥੇ ਭੜਥੂ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਚਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: lathe bhaRathoo paai guramukh machiaa ||
lines.translation: They have entered the arena with pomp and ceremony; the Gurmukhs are joyful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਰੇ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਚਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh maare pachhaaR moorakh kachiaa ||
lines.translation: The false and foolish self-willed manmukhs are defeated and overcome.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਭਿੜੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap bhiRai maare aap aap kaaraj rachiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself wrestles, and He Himself defeats them. He Himself staged this play.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa khasam ek hai guramukh jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: The One God is the Lord and Master of all; this is known by the Gurmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee likhai sir lekh vin kalam masavaaneeai ||
lines.translation: He writes the inscription of His Hukam on the foreheads of all, without pen or ink.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat melaap jithai har gun sadaa vakhaaneeai ||
lines.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, Union with Him is obtained; there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are chanted forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sabad salaahi sach pachhaaneeai ||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praising the True Word of His Shabad, one comes to realize the Truth. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰੇਂਦਾ ਵੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: oo(n)nav oo(n)nav aaiaa avar kare(n)daa va(n)n ||
lines.translation: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds are changing color.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਸੀ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa jaanaa tis saah siu kev rahasee ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: How do I know whether my love for my Husband Lord shall endure?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g rahiaa tinh kaamanee jinh man bhau bhaau hoi ||
lines.translation: The love of those soul-brides endures, if their minds are filled with the Love and the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhai bhaai baaharee tin tan sukh na hoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she who has no Love and Fear of God - her body shall never find peace. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਪੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: oo(n)nav oo(n)nav aaiaa varasai neer nipa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and pure water rains down.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੰਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dukh laagaa tinh kaamanee jinh ka(n)tai siu man bha(n)g ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride suffers in pain, whose mind is torn away from her Husband Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dovai taraphaa upaai ik varatiaa ||
lines.translation: The One Lord created both sides and pervades the expanse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed baanee varataai a(n)dar vaad ghatiaa ||
lines.translation: The words of the Vedas became pervasive, with arguments and divisions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰੈਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paravirat niravirat haathaa dovai vich dharam phirai raibaariaa ||
lines.translation: Attachment and detachment are the two sides of it; Dharma, true religion, is the guide between the two.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kache kooRiaar tinhee nihachau daragah haariaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are worthless and false. Without a doubt, they lose in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee sabad soor hai kaam krodh jinhee maariaa ||
lines.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are the true spiritual warriors; they have conquered sexual desire and anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai a(n)dar mahal sabad savaariaa ||
lines.translation: They enter into the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, embellished and exalted by the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: se bhagat tudh bhaavade sachai naai piaariaa ||
lines.translation: Those devotees are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord; they dearly love the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa tinhaa vitahu hau vaariaa ||5||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਲਾਇ ਝੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: oo(n)nav oo(n)nav aaiaa varasai laai jhaRee ||
lines.translation: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and water rains down in torrents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhaanai chalai ka(n)t kai s maane sadaa ralee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she walks in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord; she enjoys peace and pleasure forever. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬਪੁੜੇਂ ਇਸੁ ਮੇਘੈ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa uth uth dekhahu bapuRe(n) is meghai hath kichh naahi ||
lines.translation: Why are you standing up, standing up to look? You poor wretch, this cloud has nothing in its hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ehu megh pathaaiaa tis raakhahu man maa(n)hi ||
lines.translation: The One who sent this cloud - cherish Him in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis no ma(n)n vasaaisee jaa kau nadar karei ||
lines.translation: He alone enshrines the Lord in his mind, upon whom the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree baaharee sabh karan palaah karei ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, all those who lack this Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: so har sadaa sareveeai jis karat na laagai vaar ||
lines.translation: Serve the Lord forever; He acts in no time at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aadaane aakaas kar khin mahi dhaahi usaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: He stretched the sky across the heavens; in an instant, He creates and destroys.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape jagat upaai kai kudarat kare veechaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the world; He contemplates His Creative Omnipotence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh agai lekhaa ma(n)geeai bahutee hovai maar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh will be called to account hereafter; he will be severely punished.
